Empty is an observed public-roster gap, not proof that the PI has no actual students. papers.why: Old no_identity hold is resolved by the source-bound Binyi Chen / Chen Binyi binding. New 2026 references/submission entries are retained as candidate citations, not paper admissions: an owned title or a coauthor alone cannot prove this PI authorship has Tsinghua affiliation; eprint.iacr.org originals are not fetched under the project host policy.
